sentences.japanese: 我々はその畑に今年は綿を植え付けるつもりだ。
sentences.english: We will crop the field with cotton this year.

sentences.japanese: それぞれの畑はどのくらいの小麦を産出しますか。
sentences.english: How much wheat does each field yield?

sentences.japanese: その畑からはよい収穫があった。
sentences.english: The fields yielded a good harvest.

sentences.japanese: その農民は畑に麦の種をまいた。
sentences.english: The farmer sowed his field with wheat.

sentences.japanese: 道はくねくねと畑の中を走っていた。
sentences.english: The road wound through the fields.
